## Output
The contribution is registered in the actual engine instance used by the application, with scoped queries for its registered nodes and schema.

## Work
Validate types, provenance, endpoints and authenticated buildspace scope. Derived read-only facts need not be stored. Prove that changing only relational-host configuration is not mistaken for wiring the active Harness runtime.

## Why before UI cutover
We need evidence that the shared contract is genuinely admitted and queryable before views consume it.

## Evidence
Admission/rejection cases, repository-scope cases and the compiler boundary checks. Systems and type identities must come from their agreed owners.
properties.title: Admit facts in the running engine
